needed.evidence: A continuous concrete retaining wall and a line of bollards run along the left edge of the carriageway, leaving no usable footway.
needed.suggestion: Rebuild the left edge as a purpose-built footway by relocating the bollards and providing a walkable strip between the wall and the carriageway.

needed.evidence: A continuous metal guardrail and a row of advertising hoardings run along the right edge of the carriageway, leaving no usable footway.
needed.suggestion: Provide a right-side footway by setting the hoardings back and replacing the guardrail with a walkable strip separated from the carriageway.
